publication_status: Candidate evidence retained; visual follow-up required. Existing released preview is unchanged.
findings: The Windows application workflow completed successfully and produced a development ZIP; this observation has not downloaded or independently audited that ZIP.

The actual opened WPF window passed 54 checks, including selected Channel gain/pan/mute edits, shared undo, synchronized selection, numeric commit/cancel/rejection, source attachment/export, musical ruler and anchored track headers.

Actual fader thumb and scale tick positions agreed within 0.5 DIP for -96, 0 and +24 dB in both the short mixer and taller selected Channel controls. This validates the application linear-dB mapping, not the proprietary reference fader taper.
The staged session helper and independent shared Release helper each passed 52 interactive checks. The host control executable passed 91 checks with zero failures.
The shared Release gate reported 71 tests, executed 70, skipped one opt-in generator, and reported zero failures.

Visual review found the selected Channel strip vertically centered inside a stretched background, leaving a large empty area below its name plate. The 54 passing checks did not assert its bottom alignment; a subsequent candidate must correct and measure that geometry.
The hosted audio endpoint was unavailable. No device playback or audible output was measured.

observed: The compact vector toolbar and explicit event/tempo/seek fields fit the observed client width.
Separate Channel and Inspector panels identify the selected track; four complete event rows and real waveforms remain visible.
Fader scale labels are aligned with the implemented value geometry, and the selected Channel exposes the same working controls as the mixer.
Source names are readable without raw object formatting; the narrow source inspector uses vertical scrolling.
The zoomed view retains all track headers while events and ruler positions scroll.
All three captures use client dimensions without native-frame padding.
visual_review.required_correction: Bottom-align the selected Channel strip/name plate with the lower mixer; its current centered position leaves approximately 110 pixels of unused gray area below the name plate.
remaining_differences: The Channel bottom alignment is not visually accepted in this candidate.
A transient focus/hover outline can appear on a different track-name button from the selected track; selected header fill and Channel/Inspector plates still identify the correct selection.
Per-channel audio meters, additional reference controls, exact fader taper, complete interface equivalence and full application parity are not established.

waveform.oracle: Independent signed PCM16 extrema over exact source intervals

ruler.oracle: Authored constant 96 BPM, 4/4: quarter = 5/8 seconds; bar = 5/2 seconds

boundaries: All 20 retained raw records are byte-exact copies of downloaded CI evidence. No image edits or redactions were applied.

All 47 downloaded artifacts passed configured private-value/pattern and credential checks with zero blocker records. Manual review of all three images found authored project/event labels and no personal material.
The private audit reported only local com.apple.provenance extended attributes; these are not file content and are not retained in Git blobs.
The PNGs render the client visual tree of an actual opened WPF window. They are not desktop screenshots and do not capture the native frame.
UI checks use WPF automation peers and injected routed key events. They do not establish physical keyboard/mouse input, native file-dialog behavior, or hardware playback.
The candidate ZIP remains unsigned and has not been downloaded or independently audited in this observation. No release was replaced.
Passing bounded application checks do not establish complete Windows parity, general CPR project playback or proprietary reference-runtime equivalence.
